title: Are Policies Promoting the Transition to Low-Carbon Vehicles Associated With Distributional Injustice?
affiliations: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, , Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev and Hebrew University - Department of Environmental Economics and Management

detail.title: Are Policies Promoting the Transition to Low-Carbon Vehicles Associated With Distributional Injustice?

contentType.other: Paper accepted for publication at Journal of Business Research

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Business Research. Accepted for publication, 2026

detail.abstract: Are policies that encourage the transition to a low-carbon economy associated with distributional injustice? Governments often use differentiated vehicle taxes to encourage the shift toward lower-emission cars. As car markets are characterized by manufacturers' market power, such policies can generate distributional injustices, namely, unjust distribution of welfare across consumers, producers, and the environment. We examine whether such a policy delivered a just transition to low-carbon vehicles by comparing equilibrium under policy vs. a no-policy counterfactual. We find evidence of distributional injustices under the policy: (1) manufacturers captured substantial benefits by increasing markups on low-carbon vehicles, (2) despite public financing, affordability of low-carbon vehicles did not improve as planned, and consumer surplus declined, and (3) emissions decreased only marginally. We suggest reinstating a uniform vehicle tax, paired with sales requirements for low-carbon vehicles imposed on manufacturers. This combination would likely curb manufacturers' appropriation of consumer surplus and support a just transition.

AI.tldr: 研究发现鼓励低碳汽车转型的差异化车辆税收政策导致分配不公：制造商通过提高低碳汽车加价获取大量利益，消费者剩余下降，减排效果有限，建议恢复统一车辆税并搭配制造商低碳汽车销售要求。
AI.research_question: 鼓励向低碳经济转型的政策是否与分配不公相关？具体而言，差异化车辆税收政策是否能实现向低碳汽车的公正转型？
AI.motivation: 政府常用差异化车辆税收鼓励低碳汽车转型，但汽车市场存在制造商市场力量，此类政策可能导致消费者、生产者和环境之间的福利分配不公，需要评估政策是否实现公正转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于产业组织理论中的市场力量分析，结合环境经济学中的公正转型概念，探讨政策干预下的市场均衡与福利分配。
AI.method: 比较政策实施与无政策反事实情况下的市场均衡分析，评估福利分配效应。
AI.findings: 1) 制造商通过提高低碳汽车加价获取大量利益；2) 尽管有公共资金支持，低碳汽车可负担性未按计划改善，消费者剩余下降；3) 排放仅边际减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在存在市场力量的情况下，环境政策可能被制造商利用而加剧分配不公，扩展了公正转型理论在产业组织环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者采用统一车辆税配合制造商低碳汽车销售要求的组合政策，以遏制制造商侵占消费者剩余，支持公正转型。

title: Website Cookies and Voluntary Disclosure
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Website Cookies and Voluntary Disclosure

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Using website cookie information from U.S. firms' websites, I measure consumer data collected through cookies and examine how such data affect firms' accounting information environments. Cookies provide granular and real-time consumer data to firms' internal information environments and may improve the quality of internal information that managers rely on for external reporting. I find that firms with more cookies issue management sales forecasts more frequently and devote a larger share of disclosures in 10-K filings to customer, marketing, and product topics. The effects are stronger when cookie-collected data are more relevant or larger in volume and when firms have better data analytic technology. However, proprietary costs and data privacy protection mechanisms attenuate these effects. Using the California Consumer Privacy Act as a quasi-natural experiment, I provide causal evidence linking cookie-collected data to voluntary disclosure. Overall, the study highlights the role of firm-collected consumer data in shaping accounting information environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国公司网站cookie数据，发现企业收集的消费者数据越多，管理层销售预测发布越频繁，10-K文件中客户、营销和产品相关披露比例越高，这些效应受到数据相关性、分析技术、专有成本和隐私保护机制的影响。
AI.research_question: 企业通过cookie收集的消费者数据如何影响其会计信息环境？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济发展，企业通过网站cookie收集大量消费者数据，这些数据可能改善企业内部信息环境，进而影响外部报告质量，但相关研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、自愿披露理论和专有成本理论，探讨消费者数据如何影响企业信息披露决策。
AI.method: 使用美国公司网站cookie数据构建衡量指标，采用回归分析检验cookie数量与信息披露的关系，并以加州消费者隐私法案作为准自然实验提供因果证据。
AI.findings: 1. cookie数量越多，管理层销售预测发布越频繁；2. 10-K文件中客户、营销和产品相关披露比例越高；3. 数据相关性越强、分析技术越好，效应越明显；4. 专有成本和隐私保护机制会减弱这些效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将消费者数据收集与会计信息环境联系起来；2. 拓展了数字时代企业信息披露的理论框架；3. 揭示了数据相关性和分析技术的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业优化数据收集和披露策略提供参考；2. 为监管机构制定数据隐私政策提供依据；3. 帮助投资者理解企业数据资产的价值。

title: Passenger Behavior and Service Expectation Across Cultures: Implications for Global Airline Customer Service
affiliations: The Islamia University of Bahawalpur and The Islamia University of Bahawalpur

detail.title: Passenger Behavior and Service Expectation Across Cultures: Implications for Global Airline Customer Service

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study according to institutional policy because the research involved anonymized surveys of consenting adults. All participants provided informed consent and data were anonymized before analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
The current research examines the influence of cultural diversity on passenger service expectations and perceived quality of services offered by Pakistan International Airlines (PIA), with the merge of Hofstede’s Cultural Dimensions Theory and the SERVQUAL model. Some of the underperformance of PIA can be accounted for by the non-alignment between the service model of the airline – Eurocentric – and the culturally nuanced demands of PIA’s major passenger segments (South Asians, Middle Easterners and Westerners). Quantitatively collecting data from 300 passengers through stratified random sampling and testing it through PLS-SEM was used. Key findings reveal that:
1. Cultural differences have great effects on service expectations.
2. Cultural alignment increases the perception of service quality. empathy; assurance are the most touchy SERVQUAL dimensions. 
3. The service modifications reduce satisfaction whilst tempering the inadequacies in operation. The paper introduces culturally intelligent service design frame work which suggests selective HR training, and route-specific customization. These revelations are crucial to the competitiveness of PIA and appropriate to multicultural airlines.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨文化多样性对巴基斯坦国际航空公司乘客服务期望和感知服务质量的影响，结合霍夫斯泰德文化维度理论和SERVQUAL模型。研究发现文化差异显著影响服务期望，文化一致性提升服务质量感知，服务调整可能降低满意度。论文提出了文化智能服务设计框架。
AI.research_question: 文化多样性如何影响巴基斯坦国际航空公司乘客的服务期望和感知服务质量？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦国际航空公司表现不佳的部分原因在于其欧洲中心主义的服务模式与主要乘客群体（南亚人、中东人和西方人）的文化差异化需求不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 霍夫斯泰德文化维度理论和SERVQUAL服务质量模型
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过分层随机抽样收集300名乘客数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 文化差异对服务期望有显著影响；2. 文化一致性提升服务质量感知，其中共情和保证是最敏感的SERVQUAL维度；3. 服务调整可能降低满意度，同时缓解运营不足
AI.theory_contributions: 将霍夫斯泰德文化维度理论与SERVQUAL模型结合，提出了文化智能服务设计框架，丰富了跨文化服务管理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦国际航空公司提供了选择性人力资源培训和航线特定定制化建议，对多元文化航空公司的竞争力提升具有重要实践意义

title: Consumer Behavior In The Digital Age: AI, Wearables, And Tourism Experience Integration

detail.title: Consumer Behavior In The Digital Age: AI, Wearables, And Tourism Experience Integration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This manuscript is an original work derived from the author’s independent research. All data were collected ethically, analyzed rigorously, and reported honestly. The manuscript is not under review with any other journal.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Consumer behavior has been deeply reshaped by digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI), and experiential contexts that extend beyond traditional product usage into immersive commerce and tourism spaces. This article explores how modern digital interfacesfrom e-commerce platforms to AI-driven personalization and wearable technologiesinfluence consumer decision processes and behavioral outcomes. With rapid advances in AI, brands continually refine consumer experiences through tailored recommendations, automated services, and integrated data insights that change perceptions of value, convenience, and trust. Simultaneously, sustainable tourism and digital experiences introduce additional behavioral dimensions related to wellbeing, community engagement, and environmental consciousness. Drawing on recent European and international research, this article provides a comprehensive theoretical synthesis of digital consumer behavior, AI adoption, wearable technology consumption, and tourism experience dynamics. The discussion culminates in a conceptual framework that highlights key constructs shaping contemporary consumption and suggests future doctoral research directions in marketing and behavioral science.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字化转型、人工智能和体验式环境如何重塑消费者行为，重点关注数字界面、AI个性化、可穿戴技术对消费决策的影响，以及可持续旅游带来的新行为维度，提出了一个综合性的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 现代数字界面（包括电子商务平台、AI驱动个性化和可穿戴技术）如何影响消费者的决策过程和结果行为？可持续旅游和数字体验如何引入与福祉、社区参与和环境意识相关的新行为维度？
AI.motivation: 数字化转型、人工智能和体验式环境正在深刻重塑消费者行为，超越了传统产品使用，延伸到沉浸式商业和旅游空间。品牌通过AI不断优化消费者体验，同时可持续旅游引入了新的行为维度，需要对这些变化进行理论综合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字消费者行为理论、AI采纳理论、可穿戴技术消费理论、旅游体验动态理论、可持续消费理论
AI.method: 理论综合方法，基于欧洲和国际研究的文献综述，构建概念框架
AI.findings: 数字界面和AI技术显著改变了消费者的价值感知、便利性认知和信任建立；可持续旅游引入了福祉、社区参与和环境意识等新的行为维度；需要综合理解这些因素如何共同塑造当代消费模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合性的数字消费者行为概念框架，整合了AI采纳、可穿戴技术消费和旅游体验动态；为理解数字化转型背景下的消费者行为提供了新的理论视角；指出了未来博士研究的方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌如何通过AI个性化、推荐系统和数据洞察优化消费者体验提供指导；帮助旅游企业理解可持续体验如何影响消费者行为；为数字界面设计提供行为科学依据。

title: Inferring Prices from Quantities
affiliations: Yale University, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: Inferring Prices from Quantities

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper No.
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Measuring aggregate inflation is subject to two opposing biases: unobserved quality and variety growth, and the use of incorrect weights when new varieties are misclassified. We show that it is possible to measure an aggregate price index free of these biases when we have a subset of products where these two errors average to zero. This procedure does not require us to distinguish new from existing goods, measure quality attributes directly, or classify new varieties into the appropriate category. We implement this approach using BEA data from 1959 to 2019, approximating the official PCE price index with a CES aggregate of BEA prices at the product level. Our estimate of the inflation rate exceeds the CES aggregate of BEA prices by 0.3 to 1.0 percentage points per year on average. The aggregate bias was close to zero prior to the BLS introducing hedonic adjustments, which suggests that only adjusting for quality bias can lead to an underestimation of overall inflation, particularly in quality-adjusted categories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种测量总体通胀的新方法，能够同时解决未观测到的质量/品种增长和使用错误权重这两个偏差问题。通过使用BEA数据（1959-2019年）实施该方法，发现通胀率估计值比BEA价格的CES加总平均每年高出0.3-1.0个百分点。
AI.research_question: 如何准确测量总体通胀率，同时解决未观测到的质量/品种增长和使用错误权重这两个相互抵消的偏差问题？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀测量面临两个相互抵消的偏差：1）未观测到的质量和品种增长导致通胀高估；2）新产品被错误分类导致权重错误，使通胀低估。现有方法无法同时解决这两个问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CES（常替代弹性）加总框架，提出当存在一个产品子集时，这两个偏差的平均值为零，从而可以测量无偏的总体价格指数。
AI.method: 使用BEA（经济分析局）1959-2019年的数据，将官方PCE价格指数近似为产品层面BEA价格的CES加总，实施新的测量方法。
AI.findings: 通胀率估计值比BEA价格的CES加总平均每年高出0.3-1.0个百分点。在BLS引入享乐调整之前，总体偏差接近零，表明仅调整质量偏差可能导致总体通胀低估，特别是在质量调整类别中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的理论框架，能够在不需要区分新旧产品、直接测量质量属性或将新产品分类到适当类别的情况下，测量无偏的总体价格指数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和统计机构提供了更准确的通胀测量方法，揭示了传统享乐调整方法可能导致的系统性偏差，对货币政策和经济政策有重要影响。

title: Who's more Brand Loyal -Women or Men?

declarations.ethicsApproval: The data was anonymized consumer panel data obtained from the Kilts Center.

publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Purpose
This paper seeks to test prior findings and establish whether women are in fact more brand loyal than men.

Design/methodology/approach
The use of single-person household panel data provides descriptive empirics which are then incorporated into a model using additional marketing variables. 

Findings
We reveal a consistent, modest, but significant quantifiable finding that men are more brand-loyal than women across household goods in 24 categories in both the US and UK,

Originality

This is the first study to combine single-person household panel data with a measure of consumer evaluation of category gender, and avoiding the pitfalls of self-reported behaviour.

Research limitations/ implications

While the originality of the design is a key strength, it would be beneficial to extend the research approach to more categories and countries and also to see if the gender of the main shopper in multi-person households affect the patterns we identify here.

Practical implications

The finding that men are more loyal than women has implications for marketing plans and programmes. The size of the effect may be situationally specific and so need to be evaluated against potential modification costs. There may be retail opportunities to increase trial (women) or repeat purchase (men).

AI.tldr: 本研究使用单人家庭面板数据，结合品类性别感知测量，发现男性比女性更品牌忠诚，这一发现在美国和英国的24个家居用品品类中均一致成立。
AI.research_question: 女性是否真的比男性更品牌忠诚？
AI.motivation: 检验先前研究发现，澄清关于性别与品牌忠诚关系的争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌忠诚理论，性别与消费行为关系理论。
AI.method: 使用单人家庭面板数据进行描述性实证分析，结合营销变量构建模型，避免自我报告偏差。
AI.findings: 男性比女性更品牌忠诚，这一发现在美国和英国的24个家居用品品类中均呈现一致、适度但显著的可量化结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次结合单人家庭面板数据与品类性别感知测量，挑战了"女性更品牌忠诚"的传统观点，为性别与消费行为研究提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究发现对营销计划和项目有重要启示：可针对女性增加试用机会，针对男性加强重复购买；零售商可根据性别差异制定不同策略。

title: Is Vehicle Weight Associated With Risky Driving Behavior? Analysis of Complete National Records
affiliations: Ben-Gurion University of the Negev,  and Ben-Gurion University of the Negev

detail.title: Is Vehicle Weight Associated With Risky Driving Behavior? Analysis of Complete National Records
detail.abstract: A clear trend of shifting towards larger, heavier vehicles on roads fuels what has been described as an "arms race." While larger, heavier vehicles have been shown to benefit the safety of users in the event of a car crash, it is likely that consumers' experience of this increased safety will lead to behavioral adaptation towards more risky driving behavior. Using complete national data of the car fleet and policeissued speeding tickets over the course of an entire calendar year in Israel, we examined the association between vehicle mass and risky driving behavior in terms of speeding tickets. Controlling for consumers' choice of car, our results indicate a positive association between vehicle mass and speeding tickets, suggesting that larger, heavier vehicles are associated with risky driving behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现车辆质量与超速罚单之间存在正相关关系，表明更大更重的车辆与风险驾驶行为相关，这支持了行为适应理论
AI.research_question: 车辆质量是否与风险驾驶行为（以超速罚单为指标）存在关联？
AI.motivation: 道路车辆向更大、更重方向发展的趋势引发了"军备竞赛"现象。虽然大型重型车辆在碰撞事故中能提高乘员安全性，但消费者感受到的这种安全性提升可能导致行为适应，即转向更冒险的驾驶行为
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为适应理论（Behavioral Adaptation Theory） - 当人们感知到安全设备或车辆安全性的提升时，可能会采取更冒险的行为来补偿感知到的风险降低
AI.method: 使用以色列全国汽车车队数据和全年警察开具的超速罚单数据，在控制消费者车辆选择因素后，分析车辆质量与超速罚单之间的关联
AI.findings: 结果显示车辆质量与超速罚单之间存在正相关关系，表明更大更重的车辆与风险驾驶行为相关
AI.theory_contributions: 为行为适应理论提供了实证支持，表明车辆安全性的提升可能导致补偿性的风险行为增加
AI.practical_contributions: 对车辆安全政策和消费者教育具有启示意义，需要考虑车辆安全特性可能带来的行为适应效应，而不仅仅是物理安全性

title: Homo economicus or Homo rivalis: The Rival as a Reference Point in Economic Decision Making

detail.title: Homo economicus or Homo rivalis: The Rival as a Reference Point in Economic Decision Making

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with the ethical standards of the institutional research committee and with the 1964 Helsinki Declaration and its later amendments. The research protocol was reviewed and approved by the Research Ethics Committee of the Faculty of Psychology in Warsaw, SWPS University. Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants involved in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was entirely self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Neoclassical economics assumes that a rational agent (Homo economicus) strives to maximize absolute financial utility, ignoring the social context. This article challenges this approach by proposing the concept of Homo rivalis within a multi-prospect model. This model extends the classic Prospect Theory (Kahneman & Tversky, 1979), assuming that the decision-maker's utility function is two-dimensional: it includes both the assessment of a change in wealth (e.g., money) and a change in position relative to the rival's outcome.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战新古典经济学中理性人假设，提出"竞争人"概念，在多重前景模型中扩展前景理论，认为决策者效用函数是二维的：既包括财富变化评估，也包括相对于竞争对手结果的位置变化。
AI.research_question: 决策者的效用函数如何同时考虑绝对财富变化和相对于竞争对手的相对位置变化？
AI.motivation: 新古典经济学假设理性人追求绝对财务效用最大化，忽略了社会背景和相对比较，这无法解释现实中的许多决策行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论（Kahneman & Tversky, 1979），新古典经济学，社会比较理论，相对效用理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建多前景模型，扩展经典前景理论框架，引入二维效用函数
AI.findings: 提出Homo rivalis（竞争人）概念，决策者效用函数包含财富变化和相对位置变化两个维度，这能更好地解释现实决策行为
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战新古典经济学理性人假设；2. 提出Homo rivalis概念；3. 扩展前景理论为多前景模型；4. 建立包含相对比较的二维效用函数框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实世界中的决策行为提供更准确的模型，特别是在竞争环境和社会比较情境下的决策分析

reference: Journal of Development Economics, volume 162, 2023[10.1016/j.jdeveco.2022.103013]
title: Grandmothers and the Gender Gap in the Mexican Labor Market

detail.title: Grandmothers and the Gender Gap in the Mexican Labor Market
detail.abstract: This paper estimates the effect of childcare availability on parents’ employment probability using the timing of the grandmothers’ death – the primary childcare provider in Mexico – as identifying variation. I use a triple-difference to disentangle the effect of coinhabiting grandmothers’ deaths due to their impact on childcare from their effects due to alternative mechanisms. Through their impact on childcare availability, grandmothers’ deaths reduce mothers’ employment rate by 12 percentage points (27 percent) and do not affect fathers’ employment rate. The negative effect on mothers’ employment is smaller where public daycare is more available, or private daycare or schools are more affordable.

AI.tldr: 使用墨西哥祖母死亡时间作为识别变量，研究儿童保育可得性对父母就业概率的影响。研究发现祖母死亡通过减少儿童保育可得性使母亲就业率下降12个百分点（27%），但不影响父亲就业率。公共托儿服务可得性高或私立托儿/学校更便宜的地区，负面影响较小。
AI.research_question: 儿童保育可得性如何影响父母的就业概率？祖母死亡作为儿童保育可得性变化的自然实验，对父母就业有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在墨西哥等发展中国家，祖母是主要的儿童保育提供者。理解儿童保育可得性对父母就业的影响对于制定促进女性就业和家庭支持政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭经济学理论、劳动力供给理论、儿童保育约束对就业的影响理论。使用祖母死亡作为儿童保育可得性变化的自然实验，通过三重差分法识别因果效应。
AI.method: 使用墨西哥祖母死亡时间作为识别变量，采用三重差分法（triple-difference）来区分祖母死亡对儿童保育可得性的影响与其他替代机制的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 祖母死亡通过减少儿童保育可得性使母亲就业率下降12个百分点（27%）；2. 祖母死亡对父亲就业率没有显著影响；3. 在公共托儿服务可得性更高的地区，或私立托儿/学校更便宜的地区，祖母死亡对母亲就业的负面影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了儿童保育可得性对父母就业影响的因果证据；2. 展示了祖母在发展中国家作为主要儿童保育提供者的重要作用；3. 验证了公共儿童保育政策可以缓解家庭儿童保育约束对女性就业的负面影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了证据，支持扩大公共托儿服务以促进女性就业；2. 强调了在发展中国家支持非正式儿童保育提供者（如祖母）的重要性；3. 为设计针对性的家庭支持政策提供了实证依据。

title: When Eligibility Expands, Opportunity Shifts: Evidence from Parallel Search Campaigns under Automated Allocation

detail.title: When Eligibility Expands, Opportunity Shifts: Evidence from Parallel Search Campaigns under Automated Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted independently by the author in the course of professional and academic research activities. The author reports no financial, personal, or institutional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the study design, analysis, or interpretation of the results. The empirical data used in this study were derived from operational advertising systems under the author’s professional oversight, and no external organization influenced the analytical framework or conclusions presented.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses aggregated, anonymized operational advertising data at the campaign level. No individual-level personal data, human subjects, or identifiable personal information were used. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any funding agency, commercial entity, or institutional sponsor.

detail.abstract: Automated advertising platforms coordinate exposure allocation across campaigns using integrated bidding, ranking, and eligibility mechanisms. This creates interdependence in campaign performance outcomes that may not reflect intrinsic campaign effectiveness. This study examines how eligibility expansion within a shared automated search advertising account affects allocation dynamics and campaign-level performance. Using a natural operational intervention-the launch of a remarketing-restricted search campaign alongside an existing non-remarketing campaign-we apply an event-based interrupted time series design to detect allocation regime transitions. The results show a statistically significant structural break temporally aligned with eligibility expansion, characterized by an immediate level shift and persistent changes in performance trajectories. Structural break tests, placebo cutoff analyses, and robustness checks support interpreting this shift as an allocator-mediated regime transition rather than endogenous campaign deterioration or demand fluctuations. These findings provide empirical evidence that campaign-level performance metrics are structurally contingent on platform allocation governance. The study contributes to digital commerce and platform governance research by identifying allocation eligibility configuration as a structural determinant of opportunity distribution and observed performance under automated allocation systems.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，在共享自动化搜索广告账户中，资格扩展（启动再营销限制搜索活动）会通过平台分配机制引发结构性转变，导致活动绩效指标发生即时水平变化和持续轨迹改变，表明活动绩效受平台分配治理的结构性制约。
AI.research_question: 在共享自动化搜索广告账户中，资格扩展如何影响分配动态和活动层面的绩效？
AI.motivation: 自动化广告平台通过集成竞价、排名和资格机制协调跨活动的曝光分配，这导致活动绩效结果存在相互依赖性，可能无法反映活动的内在有效性。需要理解平台分配治理如何结构性影响活动绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台治理理论、自动化分配系统理论、数字广告生态系统理论、结构依赖性理论
AI.method: 采用基于事件的中断时间序列设计，利用自然操作干预（在现有非再营销活动旁启动再营销限制搜索活动），检测分配机制转变。使用结构断裂测试、安慰剂截止点分析和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 结果显示，与资格扩展时间一致存在统计显著的结构性断裂，表现为即时水平变化和绩效轨迹的持续改变。结构断裂测试、安慰剂分析和稳健性检验支持将此转变解释为分配器介导的机制转变，而非内生性活动恶化或需求波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字商务和平台治理研究做出贡献，识别分配资格配置作为自动化分配系统下机会分布和观察绩效的结构性决定因素。提供经验证据表明活动层面绩效指标在结构上取决于平台分配治理。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助广告商理解自动化平台中活动绩效的相互依赖性，指导广告账户配置策略，提醒决策者注意平台治理机制对绩效衡量的结构性影响。

title: First Impressions and Technology Adoption: Separating Primacy Effects from Selection

detail.title: First Impressions and Technology Adoption: Separating Primacy Effects from Selection
detail.abstract: First impressions are widely believed to exert persistent effects on behavior - a primacy effect. However, causally identifying the primacy effect is challenging due to selection: individuals with higher returns are more likely to adopt and to have a positive first experience. Leveraging historical playing data from hundreds of thousands of online chess players, this paper disentangles the causal primacy effect from selection. The paper studies the adoption of  "berserk" - a feature in online chess tournaments that increases the payoff of winning a match, but also the difficulty. Using a random forest, I identify players for whom winning the first time they experiment with berserk is quasi-random. While descriptive evidence suggests large and permanent primacy effects, quasi-experimental estimates reveal a primacy effect that fades within fifty games. Consistently, leveraging data from the same player on faster chess matches allows for the construction of a measure of returns to adoption, and controlling for returns to adoption in the full sample of players also renders a short-lived primacy effect. These findings demonstrate that conflating selection with the outcome of the first experimentation can substantially overstate the persistence of first impressions.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用在线国际象棋数据，通过准实验方法分离了选择效应与真正的首因效应，发现首因效应实际上在50局游戏内就会消退，而非传统认为的持久影响。
AI.research_question: 首因效应（第一印象的持久影响）在多大程度上是真实的因果效应，而非选择偏差的结果？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为第一印象会产生持久的行为影响，但难以区分这是真实的因果效应还是选择偏差（高回报个体更可能采用新特征并有积极首次体验）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 首因效应理论、行为经济学中的路径依赖、选择偏差理论、准实验识别策略。
AI.method: 1. 使用数十万在线国际象棋玩家的历史数据；2. 研究"berserk"功能（增加获胜回报但提高难度）的采用；3. 使用随机森林识别首次尝试berserk获胜近乎随机的玩家群体；4. 利用同一玩家在快速对局中的数据构建采用回报度量。
AI.findings: 1. 描述性证据显示大而持久的首因效应；2. 准实验估计揭示首因效应在50局游戏内消退；3. 控制采用回报后，首因效应同样短暂。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了首因效应的因果识别方法；2. 证明传统观察可能高估首因效应的持久性；3. 强调区分选择效应与真实因果效应的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为产品设计和用户体验提供见解；2. 帮助管理者理解新功能采用的动态；3. 为行为干预策略提供实证依据。

title: The Influence of Streamer Characteristics and Their Promotion Tactics on Consumers’ Impulsive Buying in Livestreaming Context

detail.title: The Influence of Streamer Characteristics and Their Promotion Tactics on Consumers’ Impulsive Buying in Livestreaming Context

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no interest conflict between the authors.

detail.abstract: With the development of livestreaming, livestreaming commerce has become a more and more popular commerce form nowadays. In such context, consumes are easily stimulated by streamers' personal characteristics and their selling tactics to buy products impulsively. In this paper, based on SO -R (stimulus-organism-reaction) model, we investigate the influencing factors of consumers' impulsive buying from streamers' characteristics and their promotion tactics. The mediating effect of emotional arousal between streamers characteristics and impulsive buying and the mediating effect of perceived scarcity between selling tactics and impulsive buying are also investigated. We collected a sample of 226 respondents with livestreaming shopping experience and run a structural equation model to test against hypotheses. Results indicate that both streamers characteristics and promotion tactics significantly influence consumers' impulsive buying. While emotional arousal plays a fully mediating role, perceived scarcity partially mediates the relationship between selling tactics and impulsive buying. Moreover, two promotion tactics, limited time promotion and limited quantity promotion have interaction effect on consumers' perceived scarcity. Our findings provide both theoretical and practical implications on how to boost consumers' impulsive buying through improving streamers characteristics and employing scarcity promotion strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于S-O-R模型，探讨了直播带货中主播特征和促销策略对消费者冲动购买的影响机制，发现情感唤起和感知稀缺性分别起中介作用。
AI.research_question: 直播带货中主播特征和促销策略如何影响消费者的冲动购买行为？情感唤起和感知稀缺性在其中起什么中介作用？
AI.motivation: 随着直播带货的快速发展，消费者容易被主播个人特征和促销策略刺激而产生冲动购买，需要深入理解其影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于S-O-R（刺激-机体-反应）模型，结合主播特征（刺激）、情感唤起（机体反应）、促销策略（刺激）、感知稀缺性（机体反应）和冲动购买（最终反应）。
AI.method: 收集226名有直播购物经验的受访者数据，使用结构方程模型检验假设。
AI.findings: 1. 主播特征和促销策略都显著影响冲动购买；2. 情感唤起在主播特征与冲动购买间起完全中介作用；3. 感知稀缺性在促销策略与冲动购买间起部分中介作用；4. 限时促销和限量促销对感知稀缺性有交互效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将S-O-R模型应用于直播带货情境；2. 揭示了情感唤起和感知稀缺性的中介机制；3. 发现了促销策略的交互效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为直播平台和主播提供提升冲动购买的策略：优化主播特征以激发情感唤起；2. 采用稀缺性促销策略（限时/限量）并利用其交互效应。

reference: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
title: Housing Markets and Macroeconomic Shocks
affiliations: and Stanford University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Housing Markets and Macroeconomic Shocks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Housing markets are not uniform: boom and bust cycles are larger for cheaper homes than for more expensive ones. We develop a Heterogeneous-Agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with a segmented housing market to study the determinants of house price heterogeneity. The model demonstrates that segmentation generates price dispersion and amplifies economic shocks that operate through credit constraints, but not for monetary policy. As a result, the quantitative model finds that a tightening of borrowing limits lowers aggregate consumption on impact by almost twice as much as in a non-segmented benchmark. By contrast, the segmented model delivers more uniform tiered price responses to monetary contractions. We validate these predictions using new tiered repeat-sales indices constructed from house transaction microdata for nearly all U.S. metropolitan areas. Monetary policy surprises move tiers similarly, while a tightening in payment-to-income standards generates pronounced low-tier declines. The model matches these tiered price responses and is consistent with empirical marginal propensities to consume out of housing across segments.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，分析美国住房市场的分层现象。研究发现：信贷约束冲击对不同价格层级住房影响差异显著，而货币政策冲击影响相对均匀。模型预测与基于美国大都市区微观交易数据构建的分层重复销售指数实证结果一致。
AI.research_question: 住房市场分层现象如何影响不同价格层级住房的价格波动？信贷约束和货币政策冲击对不同层级住房价格的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 美国住房市场存在明显的分层现象：低价住房的繁荣-萧条周期波动幅度远大于高价住房。理解这种异质性对评估宏观经济政策效果和住房市场稳定性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，结合分割住房市场理论，分析信贷约束和货币政策冲击在不同住房价格层级的传导机制。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并进行数值模拟，同时使用美国大都市区住房交易微观数据构建分层重复销售指数进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 1. 信贷约束收紧对低价住房价格冲击更大，使总消费下降幅度比非分割基准模型高出近一倍；2. 货币政策冲击对不同层级住房价格影响相对均匀；3. 实证数据验证了这些预测：货币政策冲击对各层级影响相似，而支付收入比标准收紧导致低价层级显著下跌。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在HANK框架中引入分割住房市场，揭示了市场分割如何放大信贷约束冲击但缓冲货币政策冲击的机制，为理解住房市场异质性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：信贷政策对低收入家庭和低价住房市场影响更大，而货币政策影响相对均匀。这有助于设计更有针对性的住房和宏观经济政策。

title: Metastability and Convex Adjustment in Elastic Settlement Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Metastability and Convex Adjustment in Elastic Settlement Systems
detail.abstract: This paper presents an interpretation of international monetary regimes based on settlement feasibility and leverage limits. The tolerated leverage multiple k is shown to function as a metastability threshold separating elastic-dominant and conserved dominant forms of adjustment. Transition beyond this threshold is continuous in onset but convex in consequence. Historical monetary episodes are interpreted as movements toward and away from this settlement boundary.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于结算可行性和杠杆限制的国际货币制度解释框架，将容忍杠杆倍数k视为区分弹性主导和守恒主导调整形式的亚稳态阈值，历史货币事件被解释为向这一结算边界趋近或远离的运动。
AI.research_question: 国际货币制度如何基于结算可行性和杠杆限制进行解释？容忍杠杆倍数k如何作为区分不同调整形式的亚稳态阈值？历史货币事件如何反映向结算边界的运动？
AI.motivation: 传统国际货币制度分析框架可能未能充分捕捉结算约束和杠杆限制在制度稳定性和调整机制中的核心作用，需要建立新的理论框架来解释历史货币事件中的模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结算可行性和杠杆限制的国际货币制度理论，亚稳态阈值概念，弹性主导与守恒主导调整形式的区分，连续起始但凸性后果的过渡机制。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与概念分析，结合历史货币事件作为案例研究来验证理论解释。
AI.findings: 容忍杠杆倍数k作为亚稳态阈值有效区分了弹性主导和守恒主导的调整形式；超越该阈值的过渡在起始时连续但在后果上呈现凸性；历史货币事件可以解释为向结算边界的趋近或远离运动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于结算可行性和杠杆限制的国际货币制度新解释框架；引入了亚稳态阈值概念来分析制度稳定性；建立了弹性主导与守恒主导调整形式的理论区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估国际货币制度稳定性的新框架；有助于识别接近结算边界的风险信号；为理解历史货币危机和制度变迁提供了新的分析视角。

title: Does Geopolitical Risk Affect Firms' Leasing Policy?
affiliations: Nova Southeastern University - H. Wayne Huizenga School of Business & Entrepreneurship and Suffolk University

detail.title: Does Geopolitical Risk Affect Firms' Leasing Policy?

declarations.funderStatement: Kershen Huang acknowledges research support from the Societal Impact Seed Grant Award Program at the Huizenga College of Nova Southeastern University.

detail.abstract: We document a robustly positive association between corporate leasing and geopolitical risk (GPR). This relation is stronger in cases where firms have greater earnings and returns volatility, face more severe product market competition, are more financially constrained, and are subject to more investment irreversibility. The impact of geopolitical risk is particularly relevant for short-term leases. Leasing during times of heightened GPR is associated with larger sales growth and higher firm value. Overall, our results are consistent with predictions of real options theory, where firms strategically use leasing as a mechanism to create flexibility in ongoing operations when facing uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业租赁与地缘政治风险之间存在显著正相关关系，这种关系在特定条件下更强，短期租赁尤其受影响，且高GPR时期的租赁与更好的企业绩效相关，支持实物期权理论解释。
AI.research_question: 企业租赁与地缘政治风险之间是否存在关联？这种关联在不同企业特征下如何变化？高GPR时期的租赁是否带来更好的企业绩效？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险对企业决策有重要影响，但租赁作为应对不确定性的灵活机制尚未得到充分研究。理解企业如何通过租赁策略应对GPR具有理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论（Real Options Theory）——企业将租赁视为创造运营灵活性的战略工具，以应对不确定性。
AI.method: 实证分析，检验企业租赁与GPR的关联，分析调节因素（收益波动性、市场竞争、财务约束、投资不可逆性），区分短期租赁效应，考察租赁与企业绩效关系。
AI.findings: 1. 企业租赁与GPR显著正相关；2. 在收益波动大、市场竞争激烈、财务约束强、投资不可逆性高的企业中关联更强；3. GPR对短期租赁影响尤其显著；4. 高GPR时期的租赁与更大的销售增长和更高的企业价值相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将实物期权理论应用于企业租赁决策与GPR关系研究；2. 识别了租赁作为应对不确定性的灵活性机制；3. 丰富了企业风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供在GPR环境下使用租赁策略的指导；2. 帮助投资者理解企业租赁决策的信号价值；3. 为政策制定者了解企业应对不确定性的行为提供参考。

title: Conserved Settlement Theory: Working Notes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Conserved Settlement Theory: Working Notes
detail.abstract: These working notes develop Conserved Settlement Theory (CST), a framework in which international adjustment is governed by settlement capacity rather than purely intertemporal optimization. Let S denote conserved settlement assets and E elastic financial claims. A settlement-backed credibility constraint implies a feasibility statistic Φ = kS/E measuring proximity to a binding settlement boundary. As Φ ↓ 1, marginal imbalance financing collapses nonlinearly, conserved assets reprice as the shadow value of scarce settlement capacity, and persistent trade imbalances become infeasible. In the conserved regime, the competitive allocation consistent with comparative advantage constitutes a Nash equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了守恒结算理论（CST），认为国际调整由结算能力而非纯粹跨期优化驱动。通过引入守恒结算资产S和弹性金融债权E，以及可行性统计量Φ=kS/E，揭示了当Φ趋近于1时边际失衡融资崩溃的非线性特征，守恒资产因稀缺结算能力而重新定价，持续贸易失衡变得不可行。
AI.research_question: 国际调整过程如何受到结算能力约束而非纯粹跨期优化的影响？当结算能力接近极限时，国际收支失衡的融资机制会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 传统国际金融理论过度依赖跨期优化框架，忽略了结算能力的实际约束。现实中，当国家结算能力接近极限时，即使存在跨期优化动机，也无法维持持续贸易失衡，这需要新的理论框架来解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 守恒结算理论（CST）框架，包含守恒结算资产S和弹性金融债权E的概念，结算支持的可信度约束，以及可行性统计量Φ=kS/E作为衡量接近结算边界程度的指标。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含守恒资产和弹性债权的框架，分析结算能力约束下的均衡条件，推导边际失衡融资的非线性崩溃特征。
AI.findings: 当Φ趋近于1时：1）边际失衡融资非线性崩溃；2）守恒资产因稀缺结算能力而重新定价；3）持续贸易失衡变得不可行；4）在守恒机制下，符合比较优势的竞争性分配构成纳什均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出守恒结算理论，为国际调整提供新视角；2）识别结算能力作为国际金融的核心约束；3）揭示边际融资崩溃的非线性机制；4）将结算稀缺性纳入资产定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供监测结算能力约束的框架；2）帮助识别贸易失衡可持续性的临界点；3）为国际金融风险管理提供新工具；4）指导储备资产配置决策。

title: Spiritual Genetic Engineering -Thee Foundation for Finatual Intelligence
affiliations: Mirracle Consultants

detail.title: Spiritual Genetic Engineering -Thee Foundation for Finatual Intelligence
detail.abstract: Orientation: Spiritual genetic engineering, in the form of renaming, is a practice that has its roots in religious sacred texts and practices. This practice is centred on the subtle notion that each letter has vibrational energy that it releases to the universe. Consequently, numerology have been used in naming and renaming processes, both at individual and corporate level. Research purpose: The main purpose of this study was to examine the role of name change and/or name addition, in the pursuit of increased consciousness. Motivation of the study: The main purpose of this study was to contribute towards the attainment of higher consciousness, a critical factor in achieving global consciousness. Research approach / Design and Method: Desktop literature review, autoethnography, gematria, and Chaldean numerology were used to achieve the study's objectives. Main Findings: It was found that names have a significant influence on people's lives, and have the capacity to suppress or support one's soul desire. Due to physical genes being passed down from ancestors, spiritual naming was found to be an effective corrective approach to address negative physical genes. Astonishingly, the results validated the claim concerning a spiritual encoding system, based on the Hebrew language. Practical Implications: The main practical implication is the conscious naming of newborns, consequently leading the rapid reversal of negative traits, ultimately leading to the rise of conscious leaders. Contribution / Value-added: Apart from contributing to the body of knowledge in the novel area of finatual literacy and intelligence, the study enhances the achievement of global consciousness. Furthermore, the study proved the claim about Hebrew being the language of creation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了通过改名或加名（灵性基因工程）提升意识水平的实践，结合桌面文献综述、自传民族志、犹太数字学等方法，验证了名字对人生的显著影响以及希伯来语作为创造语言的声称。
AI.research_question: 改名和/或加名在追求提升意识水平中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 为全球意识的实现做出贡献，因为更高意识是实现全球意识的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灵性基因工程理论、名字振动能量理论、犹太数字学（Gematria）和迦勒底数字学、希伯来语作为创造语言的理论。
AI.method: 桌面文献综述、自传民族志、犹太数字学（Gematria）和迦勒底数字学。
AI.findings: 名字对人的生活有显著影响，能够抑制或支持个体的灵魂渴望；灵性命名是纠正负面物理基因的有效方法；结果验证了基于希伯来语的灵性编码系统的声称。

AI.practical_contributions: 有意识地命名新生儿可以快速逆转负面特质，最终培养出有意识的领导者。

title: Beyond the First Amendment – Categorization and the Privatized Governance of Speech
affiliations: Brandeis Institute for Society, Economy and Democracy

detail.title: Beyond the First Amendment – Categorization and the Privatized Governance of Speech

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no CoI
declarations.ethicsApproval: na
declarations.funderStatement: no funding

detail.abstract:
This Article argues that through the design of internal harm categories and the structuring of transparency regimes, social media platforms have become the primary architects of speech governance in the digital public sphere. Platforms determine what counts as harmful expression, how rules are applied, and how enforcement is rendered visible. These classificatory choices are not technical exercises in taxonomy. They allocate discretion, structure institutional authority, and shape the conditions of public discourse. Categorization functions as constitutional design. 

Drawing on a comparative analysis of the content policies and transparency reports of ten major platforms, the Article demonstrates that the power to define and organize categories of harm enables platforms to exercise constitution-like authority over speech. By determining both the substantive boundaries of permissible expression and the metrics through which enforcement is disclosed, platforms consolidate rulemaking, adjudication, and representation within a single institutional actor. Procedural openness often masks this concentration of power, as selective disclosure and aggregated reporting preserve discretion while presenting performative accountability.

A constitutional architecture that surrounds this system establishes rather than constrains private power. Section 230 treats platforms as neutral intermediaries for purposes of liability, while the First Amendment protects them as expressive editors for purposes of autonomy. The combination entrenches a regime of privatized speech governance where private actors exercise pervasive control over the architecture of public discourse without the checks and balances that constrain state censorship. Platforms are insulated from liability as passive conduits yet shielded from regulation as speakers.

By revealing how categorical design and selective disclosure function as instruments of private constitutional power, the Article reframes content moderation as a constitutional problem of governance, rather than corporate policy or technological administration. It argues that free speech theory must confront the democratic risks posed by concentrated private control over the terms of visibility and participation. The Article proposes reconceiving transparency not as compelled corporate speech, but as a procedural right essential to democratic legitimacy, one that secures interpretability, verifiability, and contestability in privately governed communicative spaces. Such a shift would not constitutionalize corporate regulation but would restore constitutional discipline to a digital public sphere structured by private power.

AI.tldr: 本文认为社交媒体平台通过设计内部伤害类别和构建透明度机制，已成为数字公共领域言论治理的主要架构师。平台决定什么构成有害表达、如何应用规则以及如何使执法可见。这些分类选择不仅是分类学的技术实践，更是分配自由裁量权、构建制度权威和塑造公共话语条件的宪法设计。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台如何通过内容分类和透明度机制的设计，在数字公共领域行使类似宪法的权威来治理言论？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台已成为数字公共领域言论治理的主要架构师，但现有的法律框架（如第230条和第一修正案）未能有效约束这种私人权力，反而使其免受责任和监管，形成了缺乏制衡的私有化言论治理体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法理论、言论自由理论、治理理论、透明度理论。文章将内容审核重新定义为治理的宪法问题，而非企业政策或技术管理。
AI.method: 对十大主要平台的内容政策和透明度报告进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 平台通过定义和组织伤害类别，能够行使类似宪法的言论权威。它们通过确定可接受表达的实质性边界和披露执法的指标，将规则制定、裁决和代表权集中在一个制度行动者手中。程序开放性往往掩盖了这种权力集中，选择性披露和汇总报告保留了自由裁量权，同时呈现表演性问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 将内容审核重新定义为治理的宪法问题；提出透明度应被视为民主合法性的程序权利，而非强制性的企业言论；揭示分类设计和选择性披露如何作为私人宪法权力的工具运作。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出应重新构想透明度，将其视为确保可解释性、可验证性和可争议性的程序权利，以恢复由私人权力构建的数字公共领域的宪法纪律；为政策制定者提供重新思考平台治理框架的理论基础。

title: A Mind of One's Own

detail.title: A Mind of One's Own

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Philosophical Foundations and Practical Implications of Digital Humanism (eds. Julian Nida-Rümelin & Nathalie Weidenfeld), Springer.

detail.abstract: Marketed as productivity-enhancing, generative chatbots subtly usurp cognition, further taxing brain cycles already strained by other digital irritants like constant notifications. With leading product ChatGPT shifting toward ad-based revenue, the financial motivation to sustain and monetize user activity will only intensify. We have yet to fully reckon with the cognitive costs of these products that tap into the same reptilian reward system as social media's infinite (doom)scroll to optimize for engagement. What is gained, what is lost, and how will these costs be distributed? Based on the concept of analog privilege, this chapter posits that elites within the knowledge economy exercize their power to determine whether and how to engage with generative AI, resisting the pervasive pressure to cede cognitive terrain to AI. Moreover, AI amplifies and ossifies gaps between senior and entry-level knowledge workers, supercharging seasoned professionals while freezing-in-place the expertise of early-career workers. Generative AI tools are like e-bikes, trading control for speed. Without the muscle memory of steering a conventional bicycle, novice riders risk wiping out. Domain expertise, understanding AI's probabilistic reasoning and control over the "knobs" can ensure that humans remain in charge.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI聊天机器人虽然被宣传为生产力工具，但实际上会侵蚀人类认知能力，加剧数字干扰。精英阶层通过"模拟特权"选择性地使用AI，而初级知识工作者则面临被AI固化的风险。AI工具像电动自行车，用控制换取速度，需要领域专业知识才能确保人类保持主导。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT）对知识工作者的认知能力、工作流程和社会不平等产生了什么影响？精英阶层如何通过"模拟特权"来应对AI的认知侵蚀？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI被过度宣传为生产力工具，但实际上会微妙地取代人类认知功能，加剧数字干扰。随着ChatGPT转向广告收入模式，平台有更强的财务动机来维持和货币化用户活动。我们需要评估这些产品的认知成本，它们像社交媒体一样利用奖励系统来优化用户参与度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 模拟特权理论：精英阶层有能力选择是否以及如何使用AI，抵抗将认知领域让渡给AI的压力。2. 认知侵蚀理论：AI工具会逐渐取代人类认知功能。3. 社会不平等理论：AI会放大和固化资深与初级知识工作者之间的差距。
AI.method: 本章采用概念分析和理论构建方法，基于"模拟特权"概念进行理论探讨，通过类比（如电动自行车比喻）来阐明AI工具的本质特征。
AI.findings: 1. AI工具会侵蚀人类认知能力，加剧数字干扰。2. 精英阶层通过"模拟特权"选择性地使用AI，保持认知自主性。3. AI会放大知识工作者之间的不平等：资深专业人士能更好地利用AI，而初级工作者的专业知识可能被AI固化。4. AI工具像电动自行车，用控制换取速度，需要领域专业知识才能有效使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"模拟特权"概念，解释精英阶层如何应对AI的认知侵蚀。2. 发展了AI对社会不平等影响的理论框架。3. 提供了AI工具本质的类比分析（电动自行车比喻）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示知识工作者注意AI的认知成本。2. 建议通过发展领域专业知识来保持对AI工具的控制。3. 呼吁关注AI可能加剧的社会不平等问题。4. 为组织制定AI使用策略提供理论依据。

title: CEO Compensation and Earnings Smoothing through R&D
affiliations: University of Waterloo - School of Accounting and Finance, Grenoble Ecole de Management and Concordia University, Quebec

detail.title: CEO Compensation and Earnings Smoothing through R&D

declarations.funderStatement: CPA Canada–CAAA Research Program

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming at Accounting and Business Research

detail.abstract: We examine the effect of executive compensation on earnings smoothing through research and development expenditures (R&D smoothing). We find that CEO risk-taking incentives derived from stock options significantly reduce R&D smoothing. This effect becomes more pronounced following the adoption of Financial Accounting Standard (FAS) 123(R), which mandated the expensing of stock options and curtailed their use for financial reporting purposes. Moreover, these risk-taking incentives are less effective in mitigating R&D smoothing among newly appointed or inexperienced CEOs, as well as among firms experiencing extreme losses. Overall, our findings underscore a positive role for CEOs’ option-based compensation in shaping managerial R&D investment decisions: by incentivizing risk-taking, such compensation discourages R&D smoothing and better aligns managerial actions with shareholders’ long-term interests.

AI.tldr: CEO的股票期权风险激励显著减少研发支出平滑行为，特别是在FAS 123(R)实施后效果更明显，但对新任/经验不足CEO和极端亏损公司效果较弱。
AI.research_question: 高管薪酬如何通过研发支出平滑影响盈余管理？CEO股票期权风险激励对研发平滑有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解高管薪酬结构如何影响管理层的研发投资决策，特别是风险激励是否能够减少盈余平滑行为，使管理层行动更符合股东长期利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、高管薪酬激励理论、风险承担理论、盈余管理理论
AI.method: 实证分析，使用公司财务数据和CEO薪酬数据，检验股票期权风险激励与研发平滑之间的关系，考虑FAS 123(R)政策变化、CEO特征和公司状况的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. CEO股票期权风险激励显著减少研发支出平滑；2. FAS 123(R)实施后效果更明显；3. 对新任/经验不足CEO和极端亏损公司效果较弱；4. 期权薪酬通过激励风险承担，减少盈余平滑，更好匹配股东长期利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了高管薪酬与盈余管理关系的研究；2. 揭示了风险激励在研发决策中的作用机制；3. 提供了FAS 123(R)政策效果的实证证据；4. 识别了CEO特征和公司状况的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为董事会设计高管薪酬提供参考；2. 帮助监管机构理解会计准则变化的影响；3. 为投资者评估公司治理质量提供依据；4. 指导公司优化研发投资决策。

title: Defining Dishonorable Conditions
affiliations: Baylor Law School

detail.title: Defining Dishonorable Conditions
detail.abstract:
Contemporary Second Amendment jurisprudence has left American gun control efforts in a state of legal limbo. Various provisions of the Gun Control Act stand in the crosshairs, subject to ongoing litigation efforts aimed at curbing their impact. As provisions of the GCA come under fire and military veterans continue to be overrepresented in acts of gun violence, courts are likely to confront the scope and constitutionality of 18 U.S.C. § 922(g)(6) prohibiting those discharged from the armed forces under “dishonorable conditions” from possessing firearms.

This Article offers the first comprehensive statutory examination showing that “dishonorable conditions” refers not just to dishonorably discharged veterans, but to those receiving lower forms of administrative and punitive discharge stemming from myriad qualifying forms of military misconduct. When the § 922(g)(6) is given its intended meaning, conforming to veterans law’s definitions of “dishonorable conditions,” its scope encompasses up to 5.2% of military veterans, a fifty-two-fold jump from the 0.1% of dishonorable dischargees subject to firearms prohibitions under the statute’s current widespread interpretation.

Having given “dishonorable conditions” its intended scope, this Article identifies revolutionary-era American loyalty laws and oath requirements as a historical analogue for broader enforcement of § 922(g)(6). Like those who refused oaths of allegiance to the revolution, servicemembers who commit misconduct characterizing their service as “under dishonorable conditions” violate oaths of fidelity to the Constitution, Uniform Code of Military Justice, and discipline in military duty. The proto-national security concerns underlying early-American loyalty disarmament serve the same programmatic purpose as § 922(g)(6), which enforces public safety by conditioning servicemembers’ gun rights on good order and discipline in the armed forces to promote the national defense. Interpreting and enforcing § 922(g)(6) according to its intended scope tracks legislative intent, promotes public safety, and offers a historically-grounded defense to Second Amendment scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对《枪支管制法》第922(g)(6)条款进行全面的法定解释，指出"不名誉条件"不仅包括不名誉退伍的退伍军人，还包括因各种军事不当行为而受到较低形式行政和惩罚性退伍的人员。按此解释，该条款适用范围将扩大52倍，涵盖5.2%的退伍军人。文章还从革命时期的忠诚法律中寻找历史依据，为这一解释提供宪法第二修正案审查的辩护。
AI.research_question: 《枪支管制法》第922(g)(6)条款中"不名誉条件"的确切法律含义是什么？如何正确解释和执行该条款以符合立法意图并促进公共安全？
AI.motivation: 当代第二修正案判例使美国枪支管制工作陷入法律困境。随着《枪支管制法》条款受到挑战，以及退伍军人在枪支暴力事件中比例过高，法院需要明确18 U.S.C. § 922(g)(6)条款的范围和合宪性。该条款禁止因"不名誉条件"退伍的军人持有枪支，但当前解释过于狭窄。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 法定解释理论：探究法律条款的原始意图和正确解释；2. 宪法第二修正案理论：平衡枪支权利与公共安全；3. 历史类比理论：将革命时期的忠诚法律作为历史先例；4. 军事纪律理论：军人对宪法、军事司法和职责的忠诚誓言。
AI.method: 1. 全面的法定分析：深入分析《枪支管制法》第922(g)(6)条款的文本和历史；2. 退伍军人法律定义研究：依据退伍军人法律对"不名誉条件"的定义；3. 历史比较分析：将革命时期的忠诚法律与当代枪支管制条款进行类比；4. 数据统计分析：计算不同解释下的适用人群比例变化。
AI.findings: 1. "不名誉条件"不仅指不名誉退伍，还包括因军事不当行为导致的较低形式行政和惩罚性退伍；2. 按此正确解释，该条款适用范围将从当前解释的0.1%退伍军人扩大到5.2%，增加52倍；3. 革命时期的忠诚法律为这一解释提供了历史依据；4. 军人违反军事纪律等同于违反对宪法和军事职责的忠诚誓言。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次对《枪支管制法》第922(g)(6)条款提供全面的法定解释框架；2. 建立了革命时期忠诚法律与当代枪支管制条款的历史联系；3. 提出了基于军事纪律和忠诚誓言的宪法第二修正案辩护理论；4. 为法定解释与公共安全政策的结合提供了理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法院审理相关案件提供法律解释依据；2. 显著扩大枪支管制条款的适用范围，增强公共安全；3. 为立法者明确法律意图提供参考；4. 为退伍军人事务和枪支管制政策的协调提供指导；5. 为应对宪法第二修正案挑战提供历史和法律辩护策略。

title: Decentralization: A Qualitative Survey of Node Operators
affiliations: University College London and University College London

detail.title: Decentralization: A Qualitative Survey of Node Operators
detail.abstract: Decentralization is understood both by professionals in the blockchain industry and general users as a core design goal of permissionless ledgers. However, its meaning is far from universally agreed, and often it is easier to get opinions on what it is not, rather than what it is. In this paper, we solicit definitions of 'decentralization' and 'decentralization theatre' from blockchain node operators. Key to a definition is asking about effective decentralization strategies, as well as those that are ineffective. Malicious, deceptive or incompetent strategies are commonly referred to by the term 'decentralization theatre.' Finally, we ask what is being decentralized. Via thematic analysis of interview transcripts, we find that most operators conceive of decentralization as existing broadly on a technical and a governance axis. This informs a two-axis model: network topology and governance topology, or the structure of decisionmaking power. Our key finding is that 'decentralization' alone does not affect ledger immutability or systemic robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过访谈区块链节点运营商，探讨了"去中心化"和"去中心化剧场"的定义，提出了基于网络拓扑和治理拓扑的双轴模型，发现单纯"去中心化"并不直接影响账本不可篡改性或系统鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 区块链领域中的"去中心化"和"去中心化剧场"具体指什么？如何定义这些概念？
AI.motivation: 去中心化被认为是无许可账本的核心设计目标，但其含义缺乏共识，人们更容易说出它不是什么而非它是什么，需要从实践者角度明确概念定义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术轴和治理轴的双轴模型：网络拓扑（技术结构）和治理拓扑（决策权力结构）。
AI.method: 对区块链节点运营商进行访谈，收集他们对"去中心化"和"去中心化剧场"的定义，通过主题分析访谈转录文本。
AI.findings: 1. 运营商普遍认为去中心化存在于技术和治理两个维度；2. 提出了网络拓扑和治理拓扑的双轴模型；3. 关键发现：单纯"去中心化"并不影响账本不可篡改性或系统鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了区块链领域"去中心化"的概念模糊性；2. 提出了双轴分析框架（技术-治理）；3. 挑战了"去中心化直接影响系统特性"的常见假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区块链项目评估去中心化程度提供分析框架；2. 帮助识别"去中心化剧场"（恶意、欺骗性或无效策略）；3. 指导更有效的去中心化策略设计。

title: RHIS v1.1 A Human-Centered Cognitive Modeling Framework for Practical Intelligence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: RHIS v1.1 A Human-Centered Cognitive Modeling Framework for Practical Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence has rapidly expanded computational intelligence, yet this expansion has revealed a fundamental limitation: intelligence can be scaled, but judgment cannot be directly optimized. In real-world human systems—such as families, organizations, negotiations, and leadership contexts—decision failures are rarely caused by lack of reasoning power, but by breakdowns in cognitive stability, emotional regulation, and judgment under pressure.

This paper introduces the Refine Humanistic Intelligence System (RHIS), a human-centered cognitive modeling framework designed to formalize human mental dynamics as a controllable structure rather than a static trait. RHIS represents cognition through a five-dimensional model—Logic, Judgment, Emotion, Action, and Expression—and defines mathematically explicit indicators to quantify cognitive deviation, cross-dimensional entanglement, and destabilizing emotion–judgment interactions.

Across more than 150 individual cases and 20+ multi-agent systems, RHIS demonstrates strong discriminative power in separating strategic deviation from destabilizing cognitive drift, while systematically avoiding Barnum-effect generalization. The framework operates as a practical intelligence control layer, offering a structured method for analyzing judgment integrity in complex social environments and providing a foundation for human-centered AI alignment.

Formal mathematical definitions and computational procedures are provided in Supplementary Material A. Additional implementation details are withheld due to confidentiality and ongoing commercial deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RHIS（精炼人文智能系统），这是一个以人为中心的认知建模框架，将人类心理动态形式化为可控结构而非静态特质。通过五维模型（逻辑、判断、情感、行动、表达）量化认知偏差和情绪-判断交互，在150多个案例中展示了区分战略偏差与认知漂移的能力。
AI.research_question: 如何形式化人类心理动态作为可控结构，以解决人工智能扩展中判断无法直接优化的问题？
AI.motivation: 人工智能虽然扩展了计算智能，但揭示了一个基本限制：智能可以扩展，但判断无法直接优化。在现实人类系统中，决策失败很少由推理能力不足引起，而是由认知稳定性、情绪调节和压力下判断的崩溃导致。
AI.theoretical_framework: RHIS（精炼人文智能系统）框架，基于五维认知模型：逻辑、判断、情感、行动、表达。该框架将人类心理动态形式化为可控结构而非静态特质，通过数学指标量化认知偏差、跨维度纠缠和不稳定的情绪-判断交互。
AI.method: 使用RHIS框架分析150多个个体案例和20多个多智能体系统，通过数学定义和计算程序量化认知偏差，区分战略偏差与认知漂移，避免巴纳姆效应泛化。
AI.findings: RHIS在150多个案例中展示了强大的区分能力，能够有效分离战略偏差与不稳定的认知漂移，同时系统性地避免巴纳姆效应泛化。该框架作为实用的智能控制层运作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了将人类心理动态形式化为可控结构的理论框架；2. 建立了五维认知模型（逻辑、判断、情感、行动、表达）；3. 定义了量化认知偏差、跨维度纠缠和情绪-判断交互的数学指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了分析复杂社会环境中判断完整性的结构化方法；2. 为人本AI对齐提供了基础；3. 可作为实用的智能控制层应用于实际决策场景；4. 已在150多个案例和20多个多智能体系统中验证。

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以治理为中心的网络安全风险评估模型，将网络风险视为直接影响机构稳定性和董事会责任的财务风险，而非单纯的技术问题。研究结合希腊案例和NIS2指令，开发了整合概率损失估计、监管放大因子和机构弹性变量的分析框架。
AI.research_question: 大型希腊组织如何从治理角度量化网络风险？新兴的欧洲监管框架（特别是NIS2指令）如何重塑关键部门组织的问责制？
AI.motivation: 网络安全已从技术问题演变为系统性治理和经济韧性议题。希腊大型组织在关键基础设施、金融服务等领域的网络风险暴露，以及NIS2指令将网络安全提升为董事会责任，需要新的风险评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险经济学、企业风险管理（ERM）、运营韧性理论、欧洲监管框架（特别是NIS2指令）。
AI.method: 开发治理导向的网络风险资本模型，整合概率损失估计、监管放大因子和机构弹性变量，采用预期损失计算和蒙特卡洛模拟逻辑的战略决策模型。
AI.findings: 希腊的网络安全成熟度主要受合规驱动而非韧性驱动，导致系统性漏洞。网络事件不仅是运营中断，更是可能引发财务处罚、声誉损害和长期战略不稳定的治理失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 将网络风险重新概念化为治理中心的财务风险暴露，直接影响机构稳定性、监管问责和董事会责任。提出了连接网络安全投资决策与机构韧性和合规义务的政策相关框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型希腊组织提供结构化的治理量化方法，包含预期损失建模和监管乘数。提出了增强组织和国家层面韧性的治理转型框架，将网络治理定位为现代组织风险架构的核心要素。

title: Algorithmic Property
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Algorithmic Property

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: In August 2024, the Department of Justice sued RealPage, alleging its rentsetting algorithm enabled landlords to coordinate prices without ever communicating. But this case reveals something deeper than an antitrust violation: algorithms have quietly colonized American real property. From screening tenants to underwriting mortgages, computational systems now interpose themselves between owners and the practical exercise of ownership. A gap has opened between formal title and effective power. The algorithm has become a silent co-owner. While legal scholars debated digital tokens and the sharing economy, they missed this capture of the "World of Atoms" by the "World of Bits." This Article provides the first comprehensive account of "Algorithmic Property"-a regime in which traditional rights persist in form while being mediated, conditioned, and constrained by computational systems. The framework rests on three concepts: the ownership gap between title and control; algorithmic capture of property's core incidents; and Algorithmic Servitude, where computational burdens run with the land through infrastructure rather than recording. The Article documents this transformation across five domains: tenant screening, rent-setting, property valuation, mortgage underwriting, and access control. It shows why existing law fails: civil rights doctrine cannot reach discrimination it cannot see; antitrust cannot prohibit coordination without agreement; property doctrine lacks categories for burdens that bind without recording. The Article concludes with a structural reform agenda aimed at closing the ownership gap-treating discriminatory algorithms as void servitudes, establishing a "right to a human decision" for high-stakes exclusions, and imposing fiduciary duties on algorithmic intermediaries. If platforms demand the discretion of property managers, they must bear the duties of loyalty. The landlord of the twenty-first century may be a platform; property law must learn to watch back.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次提出"算法产权"概念，揭示算法系统如何在美国房地产中成为"沉默的共同所有者"，在形式产权与实际控制权之间制造鸿沟，并通过五个领域案例展示现有法律框架的失效，提出结构性改革方案。
AI.research_question: 算法如何在美国房地产领域成为"沉默的共同所有者"，在形式产权与实际控制权之间制造鸿沟，以及现有法律框架为何无法应对这一挑战？
AI.motivation: 2024年司法部起诉RealPage案件揭示了算法在房地产定价中的协调作用，但更深层的问题是算法已悄然"殖民"美国房地产，在租户筛选、抵押贷款承销等关键环节介入，导致形式产权与实际控制权分离，而法律学者却忽视了这一"原子世界"被"比特世界"捕获的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法产权理论框架基于三个核心概念：1)产权与控制权之间的所有权鸿沟；2)算法对产权核心要素的捕获；3)算法奴役——计算负担通过基础设施而非记录随土地流转。
AI.method: 通过五个领域的实证分析：租户筛选、租金设定、房产估值、抵押贷款承销和访问控制，展示算法如何在这些领域中介和约束传统产权权利。
AI.findings: 算法已成为房地产中的"沉默共同所有者"，现有法律框架在三个方面失效：民权法无法识别看不见的歧视；反垄断法无法禁止无协议的协调；财产法缺乏对未记录负担的分类范畴。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出"算法产权"理论框架，填补了法律学者在数字代币和共享经济讨论中对"原子世界"被算法捕获现象的忽视，为理解算法中介的产权关系提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出结构性改革议程：将歧视性算法视为无效奴役；为高风险排除建立"人类决策权"；对算法中介施加信托义务；要求平台承担财产管理者的忠诚义务，以缩小所有权鸿沟。

title: Defining DLT Immutability: A Qualitative Survey of Node Operators
affiliations: University College London and University College London

detail.title: Defining DLT Immutability: A Qualitative Survey of Node Operators

publicationDetails.detailsText: To appear, 9th International Symposium, SDLT 2025, Melbourne, VIC, Australia, November 20-21, 2025, Revised Selected Papers

detail.abstract: Immutability is a core design goal of permissionless public blockchain systems. However, rewrites are more common than is normally understood, and the risk of rewrite, cyberattack, exploit or black swan event is also high. Taking the position that strict immutability is neither possible on these networks nor the observed reality, this paper uses thematic analysis of node operator interviews to examine the limits of immutability in light of rewrite events. The end result is a qualitative definition of the conditional immutability found on these networks, which we call Practical Immutability. This is immutability contingent on the legitimate governance demands of the network, where network stakeholders place their trust in the governance topology of a network to lend it legitimacy, and thus manage ledger state.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过节点运营商访谈的主题分析，探讨了区块链网络中的不可变性限制，提出了"实用不可变性"的概念，即基于网络治理需求的条件下不可变性。
AI.research_question: 区块链网络中的不可变性在实际中受到哪些限制？如何理解区块链网络中的"实用不可变性"？
AI.motivation: 虽然不可变性是无许可公共区块链系统的核心设计目标，但实际中重写事件比通常理解的更常见，且存在网络攻击、漏洞利用或黑天鹅事件的风险。严格不可变性在这些网络中既不可能也不是观察到的现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区块链不可变性理论、网络治理理论、信任理论
AI.method: 采用主题分析方法对节点运营商进行访谈研究
AI.findings: 区块链网络中的不可变性是条件性的，依赖于网络治理的合法需求。网络利益相关者通过信任网络的治理拓扑结构来赋予其合法性，从而管理账本状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"实用不可变性"的概念，挑战了区块链严格不可变性的传统观念，为理解区块链网络中的实际不可变性提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助区块链从业者更现实地理解网络不可变性的限制，为网络治理设计提供指导，提高对重写事件风险的认识和管理能力。

title: Execution-Boundary Interlocks: A Governance Framework for High-Autonomy AI Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Execution-Boundary Interlocks: A Governance Framework for High-Autonomy AI Systems
detail.abstract:
As AI systems transition from advisory tools to autonomous actors with execution authority, the primary risk surface shifts from model misalignment to authority misconfiguration. Existing safety approaches largely focus on model behavior, alignment techniques, and output filtering — but real-world harm increasingly arises from over-permissioned integrations, insufficient revocation mechanisms, and weak execution boundaries.

This paper proposes Execution-Boundary Interlocks (EBI), a governance framework for high-autonomy AI systems. The core idea: every action an AI agent can take should pass through an explicit, independently enforced control point before it reaches the real world — one that can block, log, or shut down the agent regardless of what the model decides.

EBI defines how to measure governance readiness across six dimensions, how to map that readiness to autonomy tiers, how to revoke agent authority quickly, and how to maintain a clear audit trail. It draws on established security engineering patterns — zero-trust, reference monitor, safety-critical systems design — and applies them to AI agents with broad tool access.

Rather than constraining what an AI can think, EBI constrains what it can do. This means the framework is model-agnostic and stays in force even when models change or behave unexpectedly. This is a practitioner framework, not an empirical study. The gaps it surfaces — threshold calibration, high-availability enforcement, drift detection, and multi-agent policy conflicts — are identified explicitly as open problems for the research community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出执行边界互锁（EBI）治理框架，针对高自主性AI系统从建议工具转向执行实体的风险转变，强调从模型对齐转向权限配置安全，通过独立执行控制点约束AI行动而非思想。
AI.research_question: 如何为具有广泛工具访问权限的高自主性AI系统设计有效的治理框架，以解决从模型错位到权限配置错误的风险转变？
AI.motivation: AI系统正从建议工具转变为具有执行权限的自主实体，主要风险从模型错位转向权限配置错误。现有安全方法主要关注模型行为、对齐技术和输出过滤，但实际危害越来越多地源于过度授权的集成、不足的撤销机制和薄弱的执行边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于零信任、参考监控器、安全关键系统设计等安全工程模式，应用于具有广泛工具访问权限的AI代理。框架核心是执行边界互锁（EBI）概念。
AI.method: 这是一个实践者框架而非实证研究。提出治理准备度的六个维度测量方法，将准备度映射到自主性层级，设计快速撤销代理权限机制，并维护清晰的审计追踪。
AI.findings: EBI框架通过独立执行控制点约束AI行动而非思想，这意味着框架是模型无关的，即使模型改变或行为异常也能保持有效。框架识别出阈值校准、高可用性执行、漂移检测和多代理策略冲突等开放问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出执行边界互锁（EBI）治理框架，将传统安全工程模式应用于AI代理治理，为高自主性AI系统提供理论治理框架，强调从"约束思想"到"约束行动"的范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统部署提供具体治理框架，包括治理准备度评估、自主性层级映射、权限撤销机制和审计追踪维护。识别出实践中的关键开放问题，为研究和实践提供明确方向。

publicationDetails.detailsText: II Scientific and Practical Conference “Legal Regime of Information. Information in Law as a Basic Unit for Ensuring Technological Leadership”. MGIMO University, Moscow, 17.12.2025.

detail.abstract: Mission is to justify the need to outline such concepts as “data broker” and “personal data market,” recognizing them as cyber threats for the purpose of improving international cooperation in the combatting cybercrime.  Although Russian legislation does not define data brokers and personal data markets, the illegal trafficking of personal data is prohibited by criminal law. At the same time, criminological signs of the phenomena and obstacles to effective cooperation in the fight against crime have been identified, despite the adoption of the UN Convention against Cybercrime and the conduct of certain law enforcementoperations. A more comprehensive approach requires expanding the list of Russian contact points, technical tools, and the development of additional protocols to the aforementioned convention. Scientific and practical significance lies in understanding the classification of illegal trafficking in personal data under Russian law in comparison with foreign regulations and existing problems in bringing criminal charges. Given the cross-border nature and high latency of cybercrime, international cooperation is extremely important and requires constant improvement through the prism of theoretical foundations and practical cases.

detail.abstract: E-commerce has emerged as a central driver of business transformation in the United States, reshaping how firms interact with consumers, manage operations, and compete in digital markets. This paper examines the key advantages, challenges, and strategic implications of e-commerce within the U.S. context. Drawing on existing literature and industry insights, the study highlights major advantages such as market accessibility, scalability, data-driven decision-making, and personalized customer experiences. At the same time, it identifies critical challenges including intense competition, cybersecurity risks, regulatory complexity, rising logistics costs, and evolving consumer expectations. The paper adopts a conceptual approach to integrate these factors and discusses their implications for business strategy and long-term sustainability. The findings suggest that success in the U.S. e-commerce market requires a balanced strategic framework that aligns technological innovation with customer trust, operational resilience, and ethical data practices. This study contributes to the growing body of e-commerce research by providing a structured overview of strategic considerations relevant to firms operating in advanced digital markets.

title: Scaling Laws Hit a Wall: Mitigating Semantic Sorting Collapse in Medical LLMs via the HoloAuditor Topological Guardrail
affiliations: Guangdong Polytechnic Normal University, , University of Macau - State Key Laboratory of Quality Research in Chinese Medicine and The Education University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Scaling Laws Hit a Wall: Mitigating Semantic Sorting Collapse in Medical LLMs via the HoloAuditor Topological Guardrail

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or non-financial interests. This research was conducted independently, and the authors have no affiliation with or financial involvement in Google LLC or its subsidiaries.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies exclusively on computational evaluations using the open-source SymMap database and commercially available Large Language Model APIs. It does not involve any human subjects, animal experiments, or private patient health information (PHI). Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by internal project funds from Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), Guangdong Polytechnic Normal University (GPNU), the State Key Laboratory of Mechanism and Quality of Chinese Medicine (Institute of Chinese Medical Sciences, University of Macau), and The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK).

detail.abstract: The rapid iteration of Large Language Models (LLMs) fosters a prevailing assumption: successive generations inherently possess superior reasoning capabilities. However, our strict zero-shot evaluation of the latest trillion-parameter architecture (gemini-3.1-pro-preview) reveals a critical paradox. In highly structured, axiomdriven fields such as polypharmacy in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), the next-generation model exhibited a catastrophic "Semantic Sorting Collapse," plummeting to a diagnostic Hit@1 accuracy of just 6.0%. Through detailed ablation, we discovered that while the model's raw vocabulary contains the correct entities, the alignment process has scrambled the topological hierarchy. This severe ontological drift is driven by the "Alignment Tax" and the contamination of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) datasets with generalized internet noise. To address this crisis, we introduce HoloAuditor, a lightweight, pre-computed topological guardrail grounded in mathematical isomorphism. By auditing the outputs against a latent Riemannian manifold, HoloAuditor successfully rescues the accuracy of Gemini 3.1 Pro to 24.0% and enables lightweight models (GLM-4) to achieve state-of-the-art performance (57.0%). Furthermore, HoloAuditor operates with minimal latency and delivers a 40x inference cost reduction, proving that deterministic structural boundaries are the future of safe medical AI.

AI.tldr: 研究发现新一代大语言模型在高度结构化的中医药多药方领域出现"语义排序崩溃"，准确率仅6%。通过引入基于数学同构的轻量级拓扑护栏HoloAuditor，成功将准确率提升至57%，并实现40倍推理成本降低。
AI.research_question: 新一代大语言模型是否在高度结构化的专业领域（如中医药多药方）中确实具有更优越的推理能力？
AI.motivation: 当前普遍假设认为大语言模型的迭代会带来推理能力的持续提升，但在高度结构化、基于公理的专业领域（如中医药）中，这种假设可能不成立，甚至出现性能倒退。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 对齐税理论：模型对齐过程可能导致特定领域知识的退化
2. 语义排序崩溃：在结构化领域中模型内部表示层次结构的瓦解
3. 本体漂移：模型对领域本体结构的系统性偏差
4. 数学同构理论：通过拓扑结构保持语义完整性
AI.method:
1. 严格零样本评估：在中医药多药方诊断任务上测试最新万亿参数模型
2. 消融分析：识别性能下降的根本原因
3. 开发HoloAuditor：基于数学同构的轻量级拓扑护栏，通过潜在黎曼流形审计模型输出
AI.findings:
1. Gemini 3.1 Pro在中医药多药方诊断任务中准确率仅6.0%，出现严重性能退化
2. 问题根源：模型词汇包含正确实体，但对齐过程扰乱了拓扑层次结构
3. HoloAuditor能将Gemini 3.1 Pro准确率提升至24.0%，使轻量模型GLM-4达到57.0%的SOTA性能
4. 实现40倍推理成本降低和最小延迟
AI.theory_contributions:

2. 提出"语义排序崩溃"概念解释结构化领域中的模型退化
3. 建立对齐税与本体漂移的理论联系
4. 证明数学同构在保持领域知识完整性中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 为医疗AI提供安全的结构化边界解决方案
3. 显著提升模型在专业领域的性能同时大幅降低成本
4. 为其他结构化领域（法律、金融等）的AI应用提供参考框架

title: Irreducible Fallibility and the Limits of Compelled Deployment A Legal-Technical Analysis of the Pentagon-Anthropic Dispute and the Broader Crisis of AI Liability Across Professional Domains
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Irreducible Fallibility and the Limits of Compelled Deployment A Legal-Technical Analysis of the Pentagon-Anthropic Dispute and the Broader Crisis of AI Liability Across Professional Domains

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: none

keywords.keywords: AI governance; military contracting; lawful use doctrine; autonomous weapons; domestic surveillance limits; Defense Production Act; Pentagon–industry disputes; AI fallibility; liability and compliance; constitutional constraints on AI; ethical guardrails; probabilistic systems in national security

detail.abstract:
The February 2026 confrontation between the U.S. Department of Defense and Anthropic over the permissible scope of military AI deployment presents a set of interlocking legal, constitutional, and technical questions that existing American law is not equipped to resolve. The Pentagon demanded unrestricted access to Anthropic’s Claude language models for “all lawful uses,” including weapons development, intelligence collection, and battlefield operations. Anthropic refused to remove two categorical guardrails: prohibitions on mass domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons. The resulting impasse—which culminated on February 27 in a presidential directive ordering all federal agencies to cease using Anthropic’s technology and a Defense Department designation of Anthropic as a supply chain risk to national security—exposes a structural fault line in American governance: the deployment of probabilistic, inherently fallible computational systems into domains where existing law demands certainty, accountability, and deterministic reliability that no engineered system, human or digital, can guarantee.

This analysis argues that the dispute cannot be understood as a mere contractual disagreement. It implicates the outer boundaries of executive compulsion under the Defense Production Act, the constitutional limits of the Fourth Amendment as applied to algorithmically mediated surveillance, the requirements of international humanitarian law for distinction and proportionality in targeting, and the unresolved problem of legal liability for AI-driven errors in lethal and constitutional contexts. The analysis begins by confronting a foundational conceptual error embedded in the very term “artificial intelligence”: these systems are not intelligent in any meaningful sense but are human-engineered probabilistic computation systems—products of techne, devoid of the nous, phronesis, and moral agency that every legal framework examined here presupposes in the decision-maker.

 This distinction, understood by Aristotle and acknowledged by Turing, is the fulcrum upon which the collision between human-engineered technology and human-made law turns. Critically, the analysis extends beyond the military domain to demonstrate that the identical structural mismatch pervades every professional domain into which these systems are now being integrated: the practice of law, the practice of medicine, civil engineering, financial services, and the administration of justice itself. At the foundation of each of these questions lies a single irreducible fact: all engineered systems operate with an ineliminable margin of error, and no amount of safeguarding, testing, or human oversight can certify any system as incapable of producing outcomes that violate established legal limits.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2026年2月美国国防部与Anthropic公司关于军事AI部署范围的冲突，揭示了现有法律体系无法解决概率性计算系统与要求确定性、问责制的法律领域之间的结构性矛盾。
AI.research_question: 当概率性、固有缺陷的计算系统被部署到要求确定性、问责制和确定性可靠性的法律领域时，现有美国法律体系如何应对由此产生的结构性矛盾？
AI.motivation: 美国国防部要求无限制访问Anthropic的Claude语言模型用于军事用途，而Anthropic拒绝移除禁止大规模国内监控和完全自主武器的安全护栏，这一冲突暴露了美国治理的结构性断层。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 亚里士多德和艾伦·图灵关于技术(techne)与智慧(nous)、实践智慧(phronesis)的哲学区分；2) 第四修正案在算法监控中的应用；3) 国际人道法中的区分和相称性原则；4) 国防生产法下的行政强制权限；5) AI驱动错误的法律责任理论。
AI.method: 本文采用跨学科的法律-技术分析方法，通过案例研究（2026年2月冲突事件）和概念分析，探讨概率性计算系统与确定性法律要求之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.findings: 1) AI系统本质上是人类设计的概率计算系统，缺乏法律框架预设的道德主体性和决策能力；2) 这种结构性不匹配不仅存在于军事领域，也普遍存在于法律、医疗、工程、金融和司法管理等所有专业领域；3) 所有工程系统都存在不可消除的误差边界，无法保证不违反法律限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了"概率性计算系统与确定性法律要求的结构性矛盾"理论框架；2) 将亚里士多德的techne-nous-phronesis区分应用于AI法律分析；3) 揭示了AI部署在不同专业领域面临的共同法律挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了理解AI法律风险的框架；2) 为企业AI伦理护栏设计提供了理论依据；3) 指出了现有法律体系需要根本性改革以适应AI时代；4) 强调了跨领域AI治理的重要性。

detail.abstract:
India, as the world’s largest democracy, must ensure that electoral competition is conducted on a genuinely level playing field. Public infrastructure — built, maintained, and funded by taxpayers of every political belief — must remain neutral, inclusive, and free from structural advantages that benefit certain political entities over others.

Over decades, statues of political leaders who were elected to Parliament or State Assemblies have been installed at road junctions, public squares, government premises, and along major road networks across India. While originally intended as tributes, their constant and highly visible presence has evolved into a permanent form of political messaging. This creates an enduring symbolic advantage for long-established political parties whose leaders’ statues dominate public spaces across generations.

To preserve democratic fairness and civic neutrality, legislative reform is necessary.

title: Suitability of Health Information Exchange (HIE) for dentists, a qualitative study
affiliations: University of Groningen, University of Groningen, University of Groningen and University of Groningen

detail.title: Suitability of Health Information Exchange (HIE) for dentists, a qualitative study
detail.abstract: BackgroundIncreasing numbers of people with multimorbidity and polypharmacy reinforce dentists’ needs to use medical information recorded elsewhere. Dentists want to join health information exchange (HIE) networks but are concerned about usability of these networks. Thus, research is needed that compares HIE networks in the context of functionality for dentists. This study aimed to identify to what extent HIE networks meet the functional needs of dentists.MethodsA qualitative explorative design using semi-structured interviews was performed on two groups of Dutch participants: 1) dentists and other healthcare professionals, 2) information technology (IT) experts from information system vendors and HIE providers of the nationwide network of infrastructures. Recordings were verbatim transcribed by researcher and validated by participants. Transcripts were analysed using qualitative content analysis and deductive coding in line with a guide for qualitative data analysis (QUAGOL).ResultsIn total 33 participants (18 dentists/medical physicians/pharmacists, 15 IT experts) were interviewed, amongst 4 of 5 HIE providers of the nationwide network. The 5th HIE provider had no clue yet how their HIE approach could work for dentists. Dentists revealed that insight in medical history and medication was needed as well as information exchange on (oral) health related care with other healthcare professionals. Three traditional HIE networks were found to be unsuitable to facilitate needs of dentists. The 4th type, a new approach to HIE, met the needs of dentists. Latter HIE was based on a privacy respecting Trust-over-Internet Protocol (ToIP) with no restrictions on content, form of information and exchange patterns.ConclusionOut of 4 types of HIE networks, traditional HIEs were unsuitable. Only HIE based on ToIP is potentially applicable for dentists. The descriptions abstracted from the interviews regarding practice of working and needed information can be used to further design appropriate, scalable and cost-effective solutions for dentists.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了四种健康信息交换网络在满足牙医功能需求方面的适用性，发现只有基于信任互联网协议的新型HIE能满足牙医需求，而传统的三种HIE网络均不适用。
AI.research_question: 健康信息交换网络在多大程度上能满足牙医的功能需求？
AI.motivation: 随着多病共存和多药治疗患者增加，牙医需要获取其他医疗记录信息。牙医希望加入健康信息交换网络，但担心这些网络的可用性，因此需要比较不同HIE网络对牙医的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康信息交换理论、医疗信息互操作性理论、用户需求分析框架
AI.method: 采用定性探索性设计，对荷兰两组参与者进行半结构化访谈：1)牙医和其他医疗专业人员，2)信息系统供应商和全国网络基础设施HIE提供商的IT专家。使用定性内容分析和演绎编码分析转录文本。
AI.findings: 33名参与者接受访谈，涵盖4/5的全国HIE提供商。牙医需要了解患者病史和用药情况，以及与其他医疗专业人员交换口腔健康相关信息。三种传统HIE网络无法满足牙医需求，只有基于信任互联网协议的新型HIE（无内容、形式和信息交换模式限制）能满足需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了牙医在健康信息交换中的具体功能需求；2) 提出了基于信任互联网协议的HIE作为满足牙医需求的可行方案；3) 为医疗信息互操作性研究提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为HIE网络设计者提供了牙医需求的具体指导；2) 识别了传统HIE网络的局限性；3) 提供了可扩展、成本效益高的解决方案设计依据；4) 为政策制定者优化医疗信息交换系统提供了参考。
